data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse word ' Thorr,' which means 'thunder.' In Norse mythology, Thor was the god of thunder, and his name was a source of strength and protection. The name Tore carries the meaning “Thunder” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tore usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
